intent: Admit the smallest runtime seam that keeps bootstrapped SADHANA goals non-dispatchable until one explicit campaign manifest binds every goal to an exact live AgentState principal, deterministic relative workspace, zero-dollar task-correlated file lease, and canonical governance scope. Exact-principal routing and an executor postcondition prevent fallback or identity substitution without changing generic routing for tasks that carry no campaign authority.

commit.message: governance: admit SADHANA campaign authority binding

interface_mismatches: The bootstrap deliberately creates immutable authority_unbound seed markers and no principal, workspace, action, or lease placeholders; a separate typed runtime binding must remain the only dispatch authority.
Swarm boot assigns fresh AgentState IDs while the campaign contract names stable roster seats, so each boot must prove an exact-one name match and safely refresh task-bound principal identity.
The generic Orchestrator currently treats preferred agent names as hints and can fall back to another idle agent; campaign authority requires exact nested principal selection with no fallback.

Execution-lease validation treats nonzero spend as a warning and permits action supersets, while this campaign requires exactly two actions, exact canonical paths, zero dollars, stable correlation, and expiry no later than campaign end.
TaskBoard metadata and file-backed leases are separate write domains; recovery must accept only its own exact partial state and reject foreign or conflicting fragments.
honest_blockers: This admission changes no runtime code, binds no task, writes no execution lease, starts no campaign, and calls no model provider.
A manifest and exact live roster prove scoped dispatch authority only; they do not prove agent liveness after selection, semantic completion, acceptance, promotion, merge, or external publication.
The binder cannot make TaskBoard metadata plus a file lease globally atomic; it provides deterministic idempotent reconciliation and fails closed on any foreign partial state.
A busy exact principal remains intentionally undispatchable even when another idle agent exists.
The exact Orchestrator selector remains owned and separately sealed under dharmagraph-engine-2026-07; this organism packet does not transfer or broaden that sibling ownership.
CLAUDE.md and SOVEREIGN_MANIFEST.md are deterministic mirrors of ACTIVE_TRACK and confer no independent authority.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this admission, the separately declared dharmagraph exact-principal admission record, and the deterministic generated mirrors. No task, agent, execution lease, provider, process, transport, acceptance, merge, deployment, or external state is changed by admission rollback.
